bounded_inference: On this one Digits/model-family/runtime regime, a calibration-conditioned two-checkpoint switch can materially outperform direct-only and static-p90 timing, while fixed-cap switching did not meet the precommitted utility rule. This does not establish transfer to other workloads/hardware and does not validate forecasts under arbitrary runtime drift.

conditional_estimator.alternative_cost: mean min(transversal time-to-success-or-exhaustion, evaluation remaining budget)
conditional_estimator.alternative_success: fraction of calibration transversal traces whose time-to-success-or-exhaustion is successful and <= evaluation remaining budget
conditional_estimator.checkpoint: after each completed failed direct configuration
conditional_estimator.direct_conditioning: calibration episodes still unsuccessful after the same direct-config index k
conditional_estimator.direct_remaining_cost: mean over survivors of min(later direct time-to-success-or-exhaustion minus cumulative time at k, evaluation remaining budget), clipped at zero
conditional_estimator.direct_success_before_deadline: among same-index calibration survivors, fraction with a later direct success whose calibration remaining time from checkpoint k is <= the current evaluation remaining budget
conditional_estimator.raw_advantage: alternative_utility > direct_utility + hysteresis OR (direct_success_probability < deadline_success_floor AND alternative_success_probability >= deadline_success_floor)
conditional_estimator.switch: two consecutive raw-advantage checkpoints; no mid-config interruption; if remaining budget <=0 no switch
conditional_estimator.utility: P(success in remaining budget) - lambda_cost * E(capped remaining cost)/remaining_budget

evidence_quality_caveat: The durable workload/model/seed/threshold formulas were precommitted before these measurements, but the exact empirical conditional-estimator implementation was frozen after calibration and after raw evaluation traces had already been executed; mechanical per-seed maxima were visible during collection although aggregate policy simulation had not yet been run. Therefore treat the 1.0 success / 1.199s result as a strong confirmation candidate, not a pristine held-out confirmation. A new evaluation-only precommit fixes the exact estimator and new seeds before further measurement.
observations: All 12 calibration and 18 disjoint evaluation episodes completed with per-episode fsync persistence.
Static percentile collapsed to the deadline because calibration direct p90 exceeded the p75-derived deadline.
Conditional reforecast switched in all 18 evaluation episodes at the second failed direct-config checkpoint and reached the success threshold before deadline in all 18 under the frozen simulator.
